objective: Sequential focused-task campaign to improve validated learning efficiency and higher-order quantitative-research capability.
process_conclusion: The frontier-first selection PRACTICE is associated with a concrete information-flow difference: 7 distinct frontier cells were each closed once with a decisive verdict, independent-verification MATCH, and determinism, with no equivalent re-tests, whereas the prior opportunistic period repeatedly re-refined one MA-crossover cell across many activations. This is consistent with the frontier-first practice reducing equivalent search and increasing distinct hypotheses resolved per activation. The specific causal contribution of the controller's ordinal selector is NOT isolated (see unverified).

The durable history DOES adequately prevent repeating equivalent EXPERIMENTS at the level that determines research efficiency: every distinct frontier-first cell was closed once with a decisive, independently verified verdict and no equivalent re-test, the novelty guard is already codified, queue status gating skips resolved cells, and every OPEN momentum variant has a distinct information objective. The one near-duplicate code pair (momentum_sweep.py / momentum_lookback_sweep.py) resulted in a single executed+recorded lookback sweep, so the duplicate experiment was avoided. The only residual gap is a single unmarked orphan code artifact (momentum_sweep.py) that a future agent could re-run; this is code hygiene, not a research-process failure.
research_conclusion: The short-horizon momentum edge survives conservative transaction-cost stress on the 10-asset collected universe under the repository's existing realistic cost model and matched coin-flip null. Candidate-only: 9/10 positive at zero and conservative cost, none eroded (max shift <= 0.002 for 8/10; 0.05 for NVDA, already NO_EDGE). Verdict-based: COST_ROBUST=7, COST_FRAGILE=0, NO_EDGE=3 (NVDA, JNJ, XOM); lookback-5 survives conservative 6/10 (AAPL, GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA, JPM; note MSFT's lookback-5 is REGIME_DEPENDENT under cost but it survives at lookbacks 3/10 so remains COST_ROBUST overall). Independently verified (4 gates MATCH, fresh path) and deterministic; 168/168 regression tests pass. Qualification: the result is specific to the repo's constant-dollar + per-share-commission model; a bps-only stress and a strict temporal holdout remain untested. This is a positive qualification that strengthens (does not overturn) the admitted candidate; it is not a new strategy and not a negative result.
unverified: Attribution to the controller's ordinal task_rank selector specifically is not isolated: the prior frontier-first gains were produced by agent-level selection reading LEARNING_STATE, and several frontier activations (37260572520, 37318950814) were logged UNVERIFIED (process delta) because the objective came from a queued receipt item rather than a frontier cell.

Duplicate detection was by docstring/objective comparison and reference search, not by executing or diffing the two checks' numeric outputs; a byte-level equivalence of momentum_sweep.py's unique fold-t-statistic lens vs. the executed checks was not computed.

JPM's verdict-based COST_ROBUST status is a null-dispersion flip (REGIME_DEPENDENT -> REGIME_STABLE under cost) with the candidate medians unchanged; the candidate-only (null-independent) view (positive at all costs, not eroded) is the honest read and is reported alongside, not hidden.
No controlled counterfactual exists for the opportunistic selector; the before/after comparison is observational and confounded by the frontier simply containing distinct available cells.

No live wall-clock was available (bash and the `date` form are denied at this layer); the activation start is taken from the observed environment message time 2026-11-28T01:30:01Z and the before-snapshot captured_utc 2026-11-28T01:29:56Z. No finish timestamp was captured and none was invented.

No strict temporal holdout (select on early data, evaluate the most-recent untouched period once) was run; all walk-forward folds reuse the full sample, so a true out-of-sample holdout remains untested.

The audit is observational: there is no controlled counterfactual proving the novelty guard (vs. the frontier simply containing distinct available cells) is the operative cause of duplicate avoidance; attribution is confounded exactly as recorded by the P-001 audit.

The coarse top-tier discrimination of task_rank (many HIGH-benefit ties broken by task_id) means the selector's 'highest-value' claim is weak within the top priority tier; this is recorded as an observation, not a demonstrated bottleneck, and is out of scope to change here.

The current campaign 46092417292 has completed_agents=[] (campaign_status.json), so the ordinal selector has produced no completed sequence yet; its end-to-end effect on information flow is unverified.
The identical-across-lookbacks candidate medians are a pre-established framework property (activation 37394344201 horizon analysis), not re-derived here.

The proposed minimal change (mark momentum_sweep.py superseded) was NOT executed, so its independent controller validation (verification_requirement) is unmet here; it is recorded as one candidate task for a future agent that can run the controller.

The repository has no single frozen 'realistic cost model' constant; the canonical model from examples/ma_crossover*.py was used plus a 2x conservative stress. Other venues/exchange-fee schedules and a pure percent-of-notional (bps-only) cost model were NOT tested.

Under constant-dollar sizing the per-bar rebalancing cost is small relative to the edge for medium/high-priced assets, so the test is more sensitive to the per-share commission on low-priced assets (NVDA) than to a uniform bps drag; a bps-only cost stress is a complementary check that remains open.
